evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic equivalence-frame converts an unrehearsed rollback into a non-existent one, carrying urgency-as-alarm through categorical assertion rather than worry language.

mints.name: AphoristicEquivalenceAlarm
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker raising the stakes by collapsing a gap into an equivalence — asserting that what is unrehearsed is, categorically, absent?
